title: Prominence on 30A Little Bit of Heaven Prominence on 30a
meta_description: Prominence 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Little Bit of Heaven, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home with beach view and is complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly, 4 Bikes and Golf Cart Included
description_expanded: Description Description Prominence 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Little Bit of Heaven, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home with beach view and is complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly, 4 Bikes and Golf Cart Included Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A 4 Bedroom Beach House * Pet Friendly **** Golf Cart Included with Stay* 2 Main Bedrooms (One on the Main & Upstairs)* Balcony - Accessible via 2 Bedrooms* Front Porch and Back Porch with Charming String Lights, Swinging Daybed* Large Living Area - 75" Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* 3 Coffee Makers - Pot, Keurig, and Nespresso* Waring Pro Nostalgic Popcorn Machine* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - Main Level, King Bed, 56" TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - Upstairs, King Bed, 56" TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 3 - King Bed, 56" TV* Bedroom 4 - King Bed, 56" TV, Telescope* Bathroom 3 and 4 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 5 - Bunk Bed (Twin/Full/Twin Trundle), 43" TV, Arcade Game, Gaming Chair, Barn Door* Living Area - 2 Full Sleeper Sofas* Half Bathroom Main Level* Outdoor Shower* Full Size Connect 4 Game* Full Size Washer/Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Garage - Game Wall and Seating* Parking - 2 Cars plus Golf Cart* House Located on the Beach Side of 30A directly across from Pool* Sleeps 14 30A Beach Access Points PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS***We welcome well trained non-shedding dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. 20-25lbs limit. Additonal Pet Fee required and is collected after the booking is made. GOLF CART DISCLAIMERGolf carts are supplied through a third-party provider. Prior to arrival, guests must sign a rental waiver and pay a $30 fee directly to the golf cart rental company. This fee is separate from your reservation and is required to activate your golf cart rental. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools.Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
